title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Niemann’s LIV Playoff Win
items.text: Joaquin Niemann won a playoff over Talor Gooch in LIV Golf Korea for his eighth LIV title, the most since 2022, stabilizing LIV amid Saudi PIF funding ending after 2026.

items.headline: Potgieter’s NCAA Bogey Record
items.text: Louisiana's Malan Potgieter extended his bogey-free streak to 91 holes at the NCAA Championship, breaking the believed NCAA record of 74 and nearing Tiger Woods’ pro mark of 110.
